AMD supports open source a million times better than nVidia. Their open source drivers are very close to performance of the Windows ones (I am not aware that AMD has proprietary ones at all anymore). nVidia has a history of their proprietary ones breaking with kernel updates, etc. That being said, while newer AMD cards work out of the box they are slower to implement new features (Windows gets them first then Linux) but they work more natively with desktop environments for acceleration usually.
NVidia is shitty towards the open source community. Both work, mostly, but NVidia breaks more because it's all proprietary garbage.
